ctx.x: Just about everything you hear about him is like that.

Yeah, yeah, great, great person. I knew his wife, Ethel. I knew them, see I knew Gene way before they got married to Ethel. They were all with Benny Goodman; I knew Allen Reuss's wife before they married; they were all with Benny. How Gene met his wife, she was a telephone

operator at the Higby Hotel, I think that was the name of it, right across from the Paramount Theatre. And she used to call Gene in the morning to wake him up for the first show, that's how they met. Allen Reuss, knew his wife before they married. Artie Bernstein, knew his wife before they were married.
